narrative:
Meigs County has 14,303 registered voters, with 51.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 37.0% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 11.1%, a pronounced Republican lean of 25.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.4% of registrants.
